title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Aguila…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Aguila Technologies WP Customer Area plugin versions up to 8.4.3. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of other users. The flaw impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability to a limited extent. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
